title: Special Marine Warning until WED 8:45 PM CDT
text:
Severe Thunderstorms Threaten Marine Areas with Strong Winds and Hail
What’s Happening:
A Special Marine Warning is in effect until 8:45 PM CDT. Severe thunderstorms are moving southeast at 20 knots, impacting nearshore and open waters in the region.
Affected Areas:
- Nearshore Waters from Northerly Island to Calumet Harbor
- Nearshore Waters from Calumet Harbor to Burns Harbor
- Open Waters from Wilmette Harbor to Michigan City out to Mid Lake
- Calumet Harbor, Indiana Harbor, 31st Street Harbor, and other local harbors
What to Expect:
- Wind gusts up to 50 knots
- Large hail with potential for structural damage
Impacts:
- Small craft could be damaged by high winds and waves
- Large hail may cause structural damage
Safety Tips:
- Move to safe harbor until the hazardous weather passes
- Secure all loose items on deck to prevent damage
When to Check Back:
Monitor weather.gov or nwitimes.com/weather for updates.
This weather alert was produced with AI assistance using National Weather Service data.
